text:
maya: Quick idea: introduce a 'hybrid-split' routing policy that combines header priority, cookie stickiness, and weighted fallback. Aim: smoother ramp w/ affinity + percent drift. Thoughts? @alex @li

alex: Love it. We have sticky-cookie issues when header present. Do you mean header match overrides cookie affinity completely? :thinking:

maya: No — priority order: exact header -> cookie -> weighted. If header present and matches route, respect. If header absent, check cookie affinity. If cookie missing or route capacity exceeded, fall back to weighted pool. Also optional telemetry tags for which path taken.

li: Concern: path explosion in metrics. We already have too many per-route labels. Maybe send a 'split_reason' tag with values header|cookie|spill. One metric per route, tag is sufficient. cc @jorge

jorge: Agree with li. Also need an admission control for capacity: if targeted variant has 95% capacity, and we route by header it could exceed. recommend soft quota check + local spill.

maya: Sketch of config:
```yaml
policy: hybrid-split
priority:
  - header: 'x-rollout'
  - cookie: 'split_session'
fallback:
  weighted_pool:
    v1: 80
    v2: 20
spill_behavior: log_and_weight_fallback
telemetry_tags: ['split_reason', 'variant']
```

alex: One more: UX in console — show live 'path' proportions (header vs cookie vs fallback) and impact on p95. Expose sample of requests for eval set. Maybe reuse existing rollout dashboard.

eva: Ops: implementable in gateway? runtime: modify decision path in router. Also need to ensure signed cookie encryption. @sre-bot can we get a token bucket per-variant?

sre-bot: INF task created: INF-4521 for per-variant quota/token-bucket. ETA ~3w. :white_check_mark:

maya: Corner cases: Edge requests with spoofed header. Need header allowlist + signed header opt-in. Also we should support 'force=true' for support to route specific users (with audit log).

jorge: Docs note: clarify privacy implications for cookie tracking. Also default TTL 7d.

deploy-bot: Staged deploy queued: gateway-feature/hybrid-split -> canary 10% in prod next Tue

alex: Ok let's write RFC. I'll draft and link. Also need experiments to validate cookie-stickiness correctness. Anyone want to co-author?

li: I'll add telemetry specifics and dashboards queries.

maya: Thanks. I'll drop a small PoC PR against router with unit tests. PR will reference INF-4521.
